title: The Penguin Who Is A Major General
description:
Sir Nils Olav III is a king penguin at Edinburgh Zoo who is the mascot and colonel-in-chief of the Norwegian King's Guard, and holds the rank of major general. The Guard adopted a penguin in 1972 and has promoted him on each visit. He was knighted in 2008 with 130 guardsmen on parade, and the name and rank have passed through three penguins. Guinness World Records recognises him as the highest-ranking penguin, and he outranked the officer he was named after.

Source: Wikipedia, 'Nils Olav'.
